implementation: Existing AudioEngine; one persistent context, seven semantic buses, master and layer multipliers, cue gain, ducking, crossfades, stale-cue cancellation, headroom/limiter, hard scene restart, and first-cue-first start ordering.

defaults.evidence: 0.16 matches current site-presentation runtime and alpha.34 final QA.

remaining_limitations: Actual first-cue network/download/decode latency requires live browser profiling.
Mix intelligibility, quiet gaps and narration timing require actual listening.
Physical iPhone headphone and speaker listening remain open evidence gates.
Browser autoplay policy may require a user gesture.
